data.long_meaning: Derived from the Celtic name Isolde, meaning 'Goddess of the Sea'. In Arthurian legend, Isolda was the name of the beautiful queen who famously eloped with Tristan, the knight of King Mark. Her love for Tristan was so strong that a love potion was used to ensure their union.
